stop_rule: Stop expansion only when remaining routes are immaterial, fail PIT/provenance/reproducibility, are economically unjustified, or are infeasible under time/cost constraints.

material improvement in provenance or reproducibility
stop_if_all: remaining candidate sources add immaterial marginal coverage
remaining acquisition is infeasible under challenge time/cost constraints

changing the frozen W4-B family dictionary to inflate counts
